clue: I have spots like a leopard. No animal on land can run faster than me. I can zoom as fast as a car!
nudge: The fastest runner of all the big cats.

clue: I live in the sea, but I breathe air through a hole on my head. I jump over waves and click to my friends.
nudge: A smart, friendly sea animal that loves to jump and play.

clue: I dive down from the sky faster than any other animal. I grab my lunch with my sharp feet.
nudge: A fast hunting bird, a bit like a hawk.

clue: I am a long, skinny pet. I love to squeeze into tubes and steal your socks to hide them.
nudge: A long furry pet that looks a bit like a weasel.

clue: I am a pink bird. I stand on one leg in the water, and the food I eat is what makes me pink.
nudge: A pink bird with long legs.

clue: I live in Africa. I am fast and light, and I leap high to get away from lions.
nudge: A fast, small antelope with thin horns.

clue: I am a small pet with a long tail. I dig in my cage and run on my wheel.
nudge: A little pet like a hamster, but with a long tail.

clue: I am the tallest animal at the zoo. I eat leaves from the top of the tree without even jumping.
nudge: An animal with a very long neck and spots.

clue: I am the biggest ape. When I want to look tough, I stand up and beat my chest.
nudge: A huge, strong ape from the jungle.

clue: I am a small pet. I stuff food in my cheeks till they puff up, then run on my wheel all night.
nudge: A small furry pet with chubby cheeks.

clue: I am like a big, angry wasp. Knock my paper nest and I will chase you and sting!
nudge: A large stinging insect.

clue: I am a deer like animal in Africa. I can jump higher than a car to get away from a lion.
nudge: An African antelope. Also the name of a car.

clue: I have six legs and a body in three parts. Ants, bees and beetles are all me.
nudge: The group name for bugs with six legs.

clue: I hop around Australia on big back feet. I carry my baby in a pouch on my tummy.
nudge: The biggest hopping animal. Its baby is a joey.

clue: I am small and fluffy. I chase balls of yarn and mew for my mother cat.
nudge: A baby cat.

clue: I am a tiny round beetle. My back is red with black dots, and I might land on your finger.
nudge: A tiny red beetle with black spots.

clue: I am a big cat with spots. I drag my food up a tree so lions cannot steal it.
nudge: A spotted big cat that climbs trees.

clue: I have scaly skin and four legs. I lie on a warm rock in the sun, and my tail can drop off.
nudge: A small scaly animal like a gecko.

clue: I walk on the sea floor with two big claws. I am blue or brown, but I turn red when cooked.
nudge: A big sea animal with claws, like a big crab.

clue: I am a black and white bird. I love shiny things and might steal your ring!
nudge: A black and white bird that likes shiny things.

clue: I lived long ago in the Ice Age. I looked like a hairy elephant with long curly tusks.
nudge: A furry elephant from long ago.

clue: I am a big, slow, gentle sea animal. I munch on sea grass, so people call me a sea cow.
nudge: A gentle sea cow that swims slowly.

clue: I am a green insect. I hold my front legs together, like I am saying a prayer, while I wait for bugs.
nudge: An insect called the praying one.

clue: I live in the desert in a big family. I stand up on my back legs to look out for danger.
nudge: A small desert animal that stands up tall to watch.

clue: I live in the sea and have eight arms. When I am scared, I squirt ink and swim away.
nudge: A sea animal with eight arms.

clue: I am the biggest bird in the world. I cannot fly, but I run fast, and my egg is huge.
nudge: A giant bird with long legs that cannot fly.

clue: I live in the sea in a rough shell. Sometimes a pearl grows inside me.
nudge: A shellfish that can make a pearl.

clue: I am a big cat with shiny black fur. At night, I am very hard to see.
nudge: A big black cat. Bagheera in The Jungle Book.

clue: I have bright green feathers. If you say hello to me again and again, I might say it back!
nudge: A colorful bird that can copy words.

clue: I am a bird who shows off. I open my tail like a huge fan full of blue and green eyes.
nudge: A bird with a beautiful fan tail.

clue: I am a big sea bird. I scoop up fish in a big stretchy pouch under my beak.
nudge: A bird with a pouch under its beak.

clue: I am a black and white bird who cannot fly. I waddle on the ice and swim fast in cold seas.
nudge: A bird that looks like it wears a suit.

clue: I am a gray bird in the city. I walk around the park looking for bread crumbs.
nudge: A city bird that coos.

clue: I have a bill like a duck, fur like an otter and I lay eggs. I live in Australia.
nudge: A strange animal from Australia with a duck bill.

clue: I am a big snake with no poison. I wrap my body around my food and squeeze.
nudge: A huge snake that squeezes.

clue: I have long ears and a fluffy tail. I hop around and love to nibble carrots.
nudge: A hopping pet. Bugs Bunny is one.

clue: I have a black mask around my eyes and a striped tail. At night, I dig through your trash.
nudge: A masked animal that raids trash cans.

clue: I live where it is snowy and cold. In stories, I pull a sleigh full of toys on Christmas Eve.
nudge: Rudolph is one, with a red nose.

clue: I am the daddy chicken. I wake up the whole farm in the morning with cock a doodle doo!
nudge: A male chicken that crows at sunrise.

clue: I am a pink fish. I swim up the river and jump up waterfalls to get home. Bears try to catch me.
nudge: A pink fish that bears love to catch.

clue: I am a tiny sea animal that curls up. I turn pink when cooked, and people dip me in sauce.
nudge: A small curly sea food. A short person is jokingly called one.

clue: I am a small brown bird. You see me hopping around the park and on your windowsill.
nudge: A common little brown bird.

clue: I have eight legs. I spin a sticky web in the corner and wait for a fly to get stuck.
nudge: An eight legged web maker.

clue: I have a bushy tail. I run up trees and hide nuts in the ground to eat in winter.
nudge: A furry tree climber that collects acorns.

clue: I live in the sea and have five arms. If I lose one, a new one grows back!
nudge: A sea animal shaped like the things that twinkle at night.

clue: I am a little bird with a forked tail. I zoom through the air and catch bugs. It is also what you do with food.
nudge: A small fast bird. You also do it when you eat.

clue: I am a baby that swims in the pond with a tail. One day I will grow legs and hop out as a frog.
nudge: A baby frog.

clue: I am a tiny bug that eats wood. My friends and I can chew through a whole wooden house!
nudge: A small bug that eats wood.

clue: I live in the rainforest. My beak is huge and bright orange, almost as big as my body.
nudge: A bird with a giant colorful beak.

clue: I am a big farm bird. I say gobble gobble, and many families eat me on Thanksgiving.
nudge: A big bird people eat on Thanksgiving.

clue: I live in icy seas. I have whiskers, a big mustache, and two long white tusks.
nudge: A big sea animal with long tusks.

clue: I am a long, thin, sneaky animal. I can squeeze into tiny holes to catch mice.
nudge: A small sneaky animal. Pop goes this in a song.

clue: I am a chubby animal from Australia. I dig burrows, and my poop comes out shaped like cubes!
nudge: A furry digger from Australia.

clue: I look like a deer with long, straight horns. I run very fast across the grassy plains.
nudge: A fast animal like a deer, from Africa.

clue: I have a black and white striped face. I dig deep holes in the ground with my strong claws.
nudge: A digging animal with a striped face.

clue: I am a small dog with floppy ears and a great nose. Snoopy from the comics is one of me.
nudge: The kind of dog Snoopy is.

clue: I chew down trees with my big front teeth. I build a dam in the river with sticks and mud.
nudge: An animal that builds dams.

clue: I am a bug with a hard, shiny shell. A ladybug is one of my family.
nudge: An insect with a hard back.

clue: I am noisy, with a pointy tuft of feathers on my head. I am the color of the sky, and I yell at cats.
nudge: The color of the sky plus a three letter name.

clue: I am a wild hunter with pointy ears and a short tail, like it was cut off. I chase rabbits at night.
nudge: A small wild cousin of your pet kitty, with a stubby tail.

clue: I look like a big cow with huge curved horns. In hot lands, I pull carts and roll in mud.
nudge: A big strong animal with horns. Bison are also called this.

clue: I have a wrinkly face, short legs and a big jaw. I look grumpy, but I am a sweetie who loves naps.
nudge: A wrinkly faced pet that barks.

clue: I am small and yellow and I sing sweetly. Tweety from the cartoons is one of me.
nudge: A yellow singing pet bird.

clue: I am a big deer that walks in huge herds in the frozen north. The ones that pull Santa's sleigh are my cousins.
nudge: A big deer of the north, like a reindeer.

clue: I swim at the bottom of the river. I have long whiskers on my face, just like a kitty.
nudge: A swimmer with whiskers. Its name has a pet in it.

clue: I am a small striped animal. I stuff nuts in my cheeks. Alvin is one!
nudge: A small striped squirrel.

clue: I am a white parrot with feathers on my head that pop up when I am excited.
nudge: A white parrot with a feather crown.

clue: My wings are wider than a car. I glide over the mountains of America looking for dead animals.
nudge: A huge kind of vulture.

clue: I am a big tan cat of the mountains. Another name for me is mountain lion.
nudge: A mountain lion, also called a puma.

clue: I look like a small wolf. At night in the desert, you can hear me yip and howl.
nudge: A wild dog that howls in the desert.

clue: I am a little bug that chirps at night. You also play a game with this name, with a bat and ball.
nudge: A chirping bug. Also a sport with a bat.

clue: I have spikes and a long thin nose. I lick up ants with my sticky tongue, and I lay eggs!
nudge: A spiky egg laying animal from Australia.

clue: I am the biggest animal on land. I spray water at myself with my nose, and I never forget.
nudge: A big gray animal with a trunk.

clue: On summer nights, I blink a little light in the grass. Kids catch me in jars.
nudge: A bug that glows at night.

clue: I am a flat fish. Both my eyes are on the same side of my head, and I lie on the sea floor.
nudge: A flat fish. Ariel's friend in The Little Mermaid.

clue: I am small and orange. I swim round and round in a glass bowl, and you feed me tiny flakes.
nudge: An orange pet that swims. Its name has a shiny metal in it.

clue: I am a big, chunky fish with a huge mouth. I hang around coral reefs and can gulp small fish whole.
nudge: A large chunky reef fish.

clue: I am a giant flat fish. I lie on the sea floor with both eyes on the top of my head.
nudge: A big flat fish that people eat.

clue: I am a small silver fish. I swim with thousands of friends in a big school.
nudge: A small silver sea fish. A red one is a false clue.

clue: I am a friendly dog. I love to swim and fetch. I am often yellow, black, or brown.
nudge: A friendly family dog that loves to swim and fetch.

clue: I am a small, fat, furry animal in the snowy north. Some years there are millions of us.
nudge: A small furry animal of the Arctic, a bit like a hamster.

clue: I am like a big grasshopper. Millions of us fly together and eat a whole field.
nudge: A grasshopper that travels in giant swarms.

clue: I have wavy blue and green stripes on my back. I swim fast in big schools, and people grill me.
nudge: A striped sea fish you might eat.

clue: I quack on the pond. The daddy has a shiny green head, and the mom is plain brown.
nudge: The most common wild duck.

clue: I am a big monkey with a bright red and blue face. Rafiki in The Lion King looks like me.
nudge: A monkey with a colorful face.

clue: I am a big ocean fish with a long pointy nose like a sword. I jump out of the water.
nudge: A big fish with a sword nose. Nemo's dad.

clue: I am a big furry squirrel that lives on the ground in the mountains. I whistle when I see danger.
nudge: A big furry mountain squirrel, like a groundhog.

clue: I am a giant dog, as heavy as a grown man. I look scary, but I just want to lie on your feet.
nudge: A huge, gentle dog breed.

clue: I am small, brave and very quick. I fight cobras and jump away before they can bite me.
nudge: A small animal that fights snakes.

clue: I buzz near your ear at night. I bite you and suck your blood, and then you itch!
nudge: A biting bug that makes you itchy.

clue: I run free across the American West. Nobody has ever put a saddle on me.
nudge: A wild horse. Also a fast car.

clue: I am a whale with one long, twisty tooth. People call me the unicorn of the sea.
nudge: The unicorn whale.

clue: I am a small wild cat from the jungle. My fur has spots and stripes, a bit like a leopard.
nudge: A small spotted jungle cat.

clue: When I am scared, I play dead. I hang from branches by my tail.
nudge: An animal that plays dead.

clue: Your TV remote stopped working. Dad opens the back and pops in a fresh one of me.
nudge: A small power pack for toys and flashlights.

clue: I am a glass cup with a little spout, sitting on the science lab table full of colored water.
nudge: Scientists pour and mix liquids in this glass cup.

clue: Lost in the woods? My needle always swings to point north and helps you find your way.
nudge: Hikers and pirates carry it with a map.

clue: A space rock smashed into the Moon long ago and left a big round dent. What is that dent?
nudge: A bowl shaped hole on the Moon.

clue: Look closely at a grain of salt or a snowflake. It has neat flat sides and sharp corners, like a jewel.
nudge: Sparkly shapes with flat faces, like sugar grains.

clue: In a river I am the push that carries your paper boat along. In a wire, I carry electricity.
nudge: The steady flow of water or of electricity.

clue: A small pebble sinks in the bath, but a big wooden block floats. I am the reason why.
nudge: How tightly the stuff inside a thing is packed.

clue: In the middle of the day the sky goes dark, because the Moon slides right in front of the Sun.
nudge: The Moon blocks the Sun for a few minutes.

clue: You build a sandcastle and the waves slowly wash it away. Wind and rain do the same to hills.
nudge: Rock and soil slowly wearing away.

clue: Pour muddy water through me and clean water drips out, while the dirt stays stuck behind.
nudge: Coffee makers and fish tanks use one.

clue: A ball rolling on carpet slows down and stops. Rub your hands fast and they get warm. Why?
nudge: The grip between two things that rub together.

clue: I am a giant river of ice that creeps down a mountain, so slowly you could never see me move.
nudge: A huge sheet of ice that slides very slowly.

clue: You throw a ball high into the air. What pulls it back down to the ground every single time?
nudge: The pull that keeps your feet on the ground.

clue: A polar bear needs ice and cold water. A camel needs sand and sun. Each animal's right home is its...
nudge: The natural home where an animal or plant lives.

clue: Party balloons filled with me float up and bump the ceiling. I am a very light gas.
nudge: The gas that makes balloons float.

clue: I am the faraway line where the land or ocean seems to touch the sky.
nudge: Look far out to sea, where the water meets the sky.

clue: I float in the cold sea like a huge white mountain. Most of me hides under the water. Ask the Titanic!
nudge: A giant floating chunk of frozen water.

clue: The bus stops suddenly and you keep sliding forward. Things like to keep doing what they were doing.
nudge: Why a still thing stays still and a moving thing keeps moving.

clue: I am the biggest planet of all, with a giant red spot that is really a storm bigger than Earth.
nudge: The largest planet, fifth from the Sun.

clue: Hold me near a paperclip and it jumps to me without being touched. I stick to the fridge too.
nudge: It pulls iron and steel toward it.

clue: Earth is like a peach. The skin is the crust, the stone is the core, and I am the thick part in between.
nudge: The thick hot layer between Earth's crust and core.

clue: Your desk, your juice and the air in a balloon are all made of me. I am anything that takes up space.
nudge: Solids, liquids and gases are all this.

clue: I am the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun. I share my name with a shiny silver metal that flows.
nudge: First planet from the Sun.

clue: You look up at night and see a streak of light zip across the sky. People call me a shooting star.
nudge: A space rock burning up in the sky.

clue: Salt and diamonds are both me. I am found in rocks, and your body needs some of me too.
nudge: Natural stuff dug from rocks, like salt or gold.

clue: A drop of water is made of countless tiny groups of atoms stuck together. What is one group called?
nudge: A small team of atoms joined together.

clue: A car driving, a bird flying, a ball rolling. They are all in this. Stay still and you are not.
nudge: Moving from place to place.

clue: I am a huge colorful cloud of gas and dust far out in space, where new stars are born.
nudge: A star nursery in space.

clue: I am the farthest planet from the Sun, a cold deep blue world with the strongest winds.
nudge: Eighth planet. Named after the god of the sea.

clue: The center of an atom holds two kinds of tiny bits. One has a plus charge. I have no charge at all.
nudge: It sits next to protons, neither plus nor minus.

clue: Light is made of tiny packets that zoom through space. What is one tiny packet of light called?
nudge: The smallest possible bit of light.

clue: Earth, Mars and Saturn are all me. I am a big round world that travels around a star.
nudge: There are eight of these around our Sun.

clue: Lightning and the Sun are made of me. I am so hot that I am not a solid, liquid or gas.
nudge: The fourth state of matter, glowing hot.

clue: Bees carry my yellow dust from flower to flower so plants can make seeds. I can make you sneeze!
nudge: Yellow powder inside flowers.

clue: I am a tiny bit inside the middle of every atom, and I carry a plus charge.
nudge: The plus bit in the center of an atom.

clue: Mix baking soda and vinegar and they fizz and bubble into something new. What just happened?
nudge: What happens when two things mix and change.

clue: I blast fire out of my tail and shoot astronauts up into space.
nudge: Count down from ten, then whoosh!

clue: A spinning top does it. Earth does it once a day, which gives us day and night.
nudge: To turn around and around on the spot.

clue: I am the planet with beautiful rings made of ice and rock. I am the sixth from the Sun.
nudge: The planet with rings.

clue: The shop door slides open by itself as you walk up. What tiny part noticed you were there?
nudge: A part that feels light, heat or movement.

clue: On a sunny day I follow you everywhere and copy every move, but I am dark and flat.
nudge: Block the light and you make one.

clue: A traffic light, a whistle or a wave from a friend. Each one sends a message. What is it?
nudge: Phones need a strong one to make calls.

clue: I come from sand. Engineers turn me into tiny computer chips for phones and tablets.
nudge: The stuff inside every computer chip.

clue: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet. All the colors hiding inside white light, in a row.
nudge: The full band of rainbow colors.

clue: A marble, a bubble and a globe all have this perfectly round shape.
nudge: A ball shape.

clue: Squash me and I push back. Stretch me and I pull back. I am a coil of wire in a pen or a bed.
nudge: It is also the season when flowers bloom.

clue: Rub a balloon on your sweater and it sticks to the wall. Your hair stands up too! What causes it?
nudge: A tiny zap when you touch a door handle.

clue: A water bug can skate on the top of a pond. What is the outside top layer of something called?
nudge: The very outside of a thing.

clue: The planets around the Sun work together. So do your heart and blood. A group of parts like this is a...
nudge: Parts that work together as a team.

clue: Scientists test an idea again and again. When lots of proof backs it up, it becomes this.
nudge: A big idea that explains how something works.

clue: This word means 'to do with heat'. Warm clothes you wear under the rest on a snowy day have this name.
nudge: Snug underwear for cold days.

clue: A rocket shoots fire downward, and that strong push sends it up. What is that push called?
nudge: The forward push from a jet or rocket.

clue: A dark spinning cloud reaches down from a storm and sucks up everything like a giant vacuum cleaner.
nudge: A twister.

clue: I am a mountain with a hot heart. Sometimes I rumble, then blow out ash, smoke and lava.
nudge: A mountain that can erupt.

clue: I am the push that sends electricity through a wire. A big battery has more of me than a small one.
nudge: The number printed on a battery, like 1.5 or 9.

clue: Turn the TV up and I go up. Fill a jug and I tell how much space the water takes.
nudge: How loud, or how much space.

clue: On the Moon you would feel six times lighter. Your body is the same, but I have changed.
nudge: What a bathroom scale shows.

clue: I count how much electricity flows through a wire each second. My short name has three letters.
nudge: A unit for electric flow, named after a French scientist.

clue: I stick up from a radio or a car roof to catch signals out of the air. Insects have two of me too.
nudge: Bugs and butterflies feel with them.

clue: I am a big rocky lump floating around the Sun, too small to be a planet. Lots of us live past Mars.
nudge: A space rock, maybe like the one that ended the dinosaurs.

clue: We are tiny living things too small to see. Some make you sick, others help turn milk into yogurt.
nudge: Many germs are these tiny living things.

clue: You love watching ants, frogs, trees and whales and asking how they live. Which science is that?
nudge: The study of life.

clue: You study flowers, trees, leaves and seeds in this science.
nudge: Plant science.

clue: I am in coal, in pencils and in sparkling diamonds. Every living thing has me inside.
nudge: The black stuff on burnt toast.

clue: On this temperature scale, water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100.
nudge: The C after a temperature in a weather report.

clue: Bleach, soap and the powders in a science kit are all this. Never mix them without a grown up!
nudge: A substance scientists mix in a lab.

clue: I am what makes the swimming pool smell funny. I kill germs so the water stays clean.
nudge: Pool cleaner.

clue: I am a metal that gives glass and paint a deep, rich blue color.
nudge: A shade of dark blue has my name.

clue: Water and salt are each two different elements joined into something new. What is that called?
nudge: Two or more elements locked together.

clue: Take a cold drink outside and tiny drops form on the glass. The water in the air did this.
nudge: Gas turning back into liquid.

clue: I am a reddish brown metal. Wires inside walls are made of me, and so are pennies.
nudge: The Statue of Liberty is made of this metal.

clue: A soup can and a toilet paper roll have this shape: round on both ends and straight down the side.
nudge: A tube shape.

clue: A whisper is low on my scale and a jet plane is very high. I measure how loud a sound is.
nudge: The unit for loudness.

clue: A drawing with labels that shows the parts of a plant or a bike and how they fit together.
nudge: A picture with labels.

clue: Draw a line straight across a circle, right through the middle, from one side to the other.
nudge: Twice the radius.

clue: T. rex was one of us. We ruled Earth millions of years ago, and now only our bones are left.
nudge: A giant reptile from long ago.

clue: Stir sugar into hot tea and it seems to vanish. Where did it go? It did this.
nudge: To mix into a liquid and disappear.

clue: A little wheel on a bike rubs the tire and turns your pedaling into power for the lamp.
nudge: A machine that turns spinning into electricity.

clue: The science of how plants, animals and their homes all depend on each other.
nudge: Studying nature and how living things fit together.

clue: A car that plugs in to charge, a toothbrush that buzzes. Both run on this kind of power.
nudge: Powered by plugs and batteries.

clue: I am a tiny bit with a minus charge that zooms around the outside of an atom.
nudge: It moves along wires to make power flow.

clue: Gold, oxygen and iron are each made of only one kind of atom. Each is one of me.
nudge: There are over 100 of these on a big chart in science class.

clue: Smoke from a car's tailpipe is one. So is the light from a bulb. Something sent out into the air.
nudge: Stuff that is given off or released.

clue: 2 + 3 = 5 is one. A math sentence where the two sides balance.
nudge: A math sentence with a balance in the middle.

clue: Deep inside the Sun, tiny atoms crash and join together, making light and heat. What is this?
nudge: Joining things into one.

clue: Why do you have your mom's eyes and your dad's curly hair? This science explains it.
nudge: The study of how looks pass from parents to kids.

clue: You collect rocks and wonder why volcanoes erupt and the ground shakes. Which science is made for you?
nudge: The study of the Earth and its rocks.

clue: I am a very hard, speckled rock. Kitchen counters and big statues are often made of me.
nudge: A tough gray or pink rock with spots.

clue: I am the soft gray stuff inside your pencil that leaves a mark on paper.
nudge: Pencil 'lead' is really this.

clue: Some very bright car lights and lamps are named after me. Chlorine is part of my family.
nudge: A family of elements that includes chlorine.

clue: On a sticky summer day the air feels wet and heavy. That is because I am high.
nudge: How much water is in the air.

clue: I am the lightest thing in the universe and the main fuel of stars. Join me with oxygen to make water.
nudge: The H in H2O.

clue: Leaves turn red and gold and crunch under your shoes. Which season comes right after summer?
nudge: In America it is also called fall.

clue: In spring, an apple tree is covered in pink and white flowers before any fruit grows. What are they?
nudge: A flower on a fruit tree.

clue: I am a rock so huge and heavy that you cannot pick me up with your hands.
nudge: A giant rock.

clue: Birds build nests on me. I grow out of a tree trunk like an arm holding up the leaves.
nudge: A tree's arm.

clue: I live in the hot desert. I store water in my fat green stem and grow sharp spines, not leaves.
nudge: A prickly desert plant.

clue: I am a giant, dark room deep inside a mountain, with rock icicles hanging from the roof.
nudge: A huge underground hall made of rock.

clue: Deserts are usually hot and dry. The poles are always icy. The usual weather of a place, year after year.
nudge: Weather over many, many years.

clue: India, Brazil and Japan are each one. I have my own flag and my own team at the World Cup.
nudge: A nation.

clue: A giant storm spins in a huge circle over the sea, with howling winds and a calm eye in the middle.
nudge: A huge spinning storm.

clue: Camels walk across my hot sand. It almost never rains here.
nudge: Hot, dry and sandy.

clue: No rain for months. The ground cracks, rivers dry up and plants turn brown.
nudge: A long time without rain.

clue: I am a pretend line around the middle of the globe, halfway between the North and South Poles.
nudge: The hot belt around the middle of the world.

clue: Where a river flows into the sea, fresh water and salty water mix together. What is this place?
nudge: The wide mouth of a river.

clue: Bees and butterflies visit me for my sweet smell and bright colors. Pick me for Mom!
nudge: A rose or a daisy.
